name: meeting-notes-to-action-items
description: Turn raw meeting notes into a summary, decisions and an action-item checklist. The workflow pauses so you can choose which items to keep before it writes the file.

notes_file.description: Text or Markdown file with the meeting notes

output_file.description: Where the Markdown checklist is written

steps.pipeline: llm.invoke --prompt 'Read these meeting notes. Return: title (short meeting name), summary (2 sentences), decisions (list of strings), and action_items: every concrete task with task (start with a verb), owner (a name from the notes, or "unassigned"), due (as written in the notes, or "none") and priority (high, medium or low). Do not invent tasks that are not in the notes.' --output-schema '{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string"},"summary":{"type":"string"},"decisions":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"action_items":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"object","properties":{"task":{"type":"string"},"owner":{"type":"string"},"due":{"type":"string"},"priority":{"type":"string","enum":["high","medium","low"]}},"required":["task","owner","due","priority"]}}},"required":["title","summary","decisions","action_items"]}'

steps.run: node -e 'const d = JSON.parse(process.env.DATA); const lines = [d.title, "", d.summary, "", "Proposed action items:"]; d.action_items.forEach((a, i) => lines.push((i + 1) + ". " + a.task + " — " + a.owner + ", due " + a.due + " [" + a.priority + "]")); console.log(lines.join("\n"))'

input.prompt: Which action items should go on the list? Answer "all" or item numbers like "1,3,4". You can also add a note for the file.

note.description: Optional note added to the top of the file

steps.run: node -e 'const fs = require("fs"); const path = require("path"); const d = JSON.parse(process.env.DATA); const answer = JSON.parse(process.env.ANSWER); const keep = String(answer.keep).trim().toLowerCase(); const wanted = keep === "all" ? null : keep.split(/[ ,]+/).map(Number).filter(Boolean); const items = d.action_items.filter((a, i) => !wanted || wanted.includes(i + 1)); const md = ["# " + d.title, ""]; if (answer.note) md.push("> " + answer.note, ""); md.push("## Summary", "", d.summary, "", "## Decisions", ""); d.decisions.forEach(x => md.push("- " + x)); md.push("", "## Action items", ""); items.forEach(a => md.push("- [ ] **" + a.task + "** — " + a.owner + " · due " + a.due + " · " + a.priority)); const file = process.env.LOBSTER_ARG_OUTPUT_FILE.replace(/^~(?=\/|$)/, require("os").homedir()); fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(file), { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(file, md.join("\n") + "\n"); console.log("📝 Wrote " + items.length + " of " + d.action_items.length + " action items to " + file)'
